requirements.title: Unequal-length bit comparisons left-pad with zeros
requirements.definition: When unequal-length bit sequences are compared, the shorter is considered extended to the longer length by left-padding with zero bits.

pending.bit-comparison-left-zero-padding: Use BGE/BGT/BLE/BLT on nonnegative operands chosen so left zero padding changes the first unequal position; assert exact logical results.

requirements.title: Bit comparisons proceed left to right with zero less than one
requirements.definition: Bit sequences are compared left to right until unequal bits are found or all bits are equal; zero is less than one at the unequal position, otherwise the sequences are equal.

pending.bit-comparison-left-to-right: Use nonnegative values with one high-order differing bit and identical controls; assert BGT/BLT/BGE/BLE exact logical outcomes.

review_rationale: Source registration for Clause 16 general text, 16 through 16.8: intrinsic procedure classes and general rules, the bit and numeric models, atomic and collective subroutines, and the standard generic and specific name tables (batch178). This opens Clause 16. Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across two rounds; round 1 found conditional pending plans for the atomic and collective STAT semantics, now resolved into explicit decisions: image-dependent facets are out of scope for single-image fixtures by user decision, and the 'any other error' STAT values have no portable oracle because such an error cannot be induced portably. C1601 and C1602 were pre-accounted. Source accounting only.
